quest.title: Good Medicine Is Hard to Come By
quest.description: Maruf from Aaru Village seems to be having some trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: *sigh* This condition is tricky. I'd better get Dr. Zakariya's help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is someone gravely ill?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Eh? Ah, Traveler! Nobody's gravely ill. It's just that a patient's got a severe case of headache.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I gave him some medicine, but it didn't really work that well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you tried prescribing other medicine?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Ahem... That would've been far beyond me. You see, with my limited experience, I can only come up with this many prescriptions...

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: They can treat mild conditions alright, but when it comes to serious ones, they're next to useless.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Luckily, Dr. Zakariya at Bimarstan has offered to prescribe medicine and get the ingredients ready for me...

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Traveler, can I ask you a favor?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I've got some patients to attend to, so could you visit Dr. Zakariya in my stead and ask him to prescribe something?

choices.text: Does Zakariya ever come to the village?

response.speaker: Maruf
response.text: He occasionally has people send herbs and stuff over, but he's too busy to show up in person, really.

response.speaker: Maruf
response.text: Anyway, about that prescription — I'm counting on you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Why am I having more and more patients lately...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Maruf...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Maruf? Did he run into some little-understood illness again?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe the condition Maruf is treating...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: *sigh* How many times have I told him? He's fully capable of handling something this simple on his own — without needing my help!

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: I bet the patients are exaggerating their discomfort again, thinking that a mere village doctor is unable to treat their "serious illness."

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: That's why Maruf wants my prescription to reassure them.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Looking after the villagers for so many years has definitely not been an easy task for Maruf... I'll write up a prescription right away. Please take note, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Um, I remember Maruf is treating a patient with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A headache.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Ah, I see. To treat headaches, the prescription that I gave him last time will do.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Brew up a herbal soup out of the ingredients listed in the prescription and add three portions of <color=#00E1FFFF>Mint</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: After that, keep boiling the soup on a <color=#00E1FFFF>high flame</color> for around... Forget it... Boil it until <color=#00E1FFFF>the ingredients float</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Um... Just in case you forget, I'll write it down.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Zakariya writes down the prescription...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Please deliver the prescription to Maruf.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: To be honest, I wouldn't say what I prescribed is "medicine." Instead, it's more of a... How should I put it...

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: Well, it's more of a mild, nutritious supplement.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: One can be as creative as they want with the prescription. The worst thing they might end up with is a useless soup, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: *sigh* Actually, all Maruf had to do was to adjust his original prescription very slightly. Why couldn't he put more trust in himself?

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: After that, keep boiling the soup on a high flame. In fact, I'd suggest a brief <color=#00E1FFFF>high flame</color> first before leaving it on a <color=#00E1FFFF>low flame</color> for a bit longer, until <color=#00E1FFFF>the soup deepens in color</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, you're back! What did Zakariya say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zakariya's prescription...

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: It says to use the soup he prescribed last time as the base? I see... Let me check the instructions more carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Eh? His writing is, um, unsurprisingly still so hard to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Traveler, he told you how to brew it and what ingredients are needed, right?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Could you watch my steps? Let me know if I make any mistakes.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: The ingredients are... Ugh... Totally unintelligible...

choices.text: Brew on a high flame throughout.

response.speaker: Maruf
response.text: Got it. Allow me to check the prescription one more time, just in case we missed something.

choices.text: Until the soup deepens in color.
